burrata.name: Burrata & pusaka tomat
burrata.short: Burrata creamy, tomat asak, sourdough grilled.
burrata.description: Bal lemes tina burrata seger, tomat pusaka amis sarta Basil, réngsé kalawan minyak zaitun. Sendok eta kalawan sourdough grilled haneut.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (susu), tomat, Basil, minyak zaitun, sourdough (gandum), uyah laut.

dumplings.name: Pangsit cabe
dumplings.short: Pangsit sayur emas, minyak cabe, daun bawang.
dumplings.description: Genep pangsit sayur pan-seared kalawan handap garing sarta puseur lemes. Rengse ku minyak cabe jeung daun bawang, jeung sambel kécap di sisi.
dumplings.ingredients: Bungkus gandum, kol, suung, wortel, daun bawang, kecap (kécap, gandum), wijen, minyak cabe.

pasta.name: Tomat & basil rigatoni
pasta.description: pasta Ridged tossed dina euyeub, saos tomat slow-Anggang, kalawan Basil seger jeung parmesan vegetarian. Nyaman, sederhana, sareng didamel kanggo tuang siang anu panjang.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (gandum), tomat, Basil, parmesan vegetarian (susu), minyak zaitun, bawang bodas.

salad.name: Mangkuk kebon anggang
salad.description: Beets Anggang jeung kentang amis leuwih greens garing, kalawan chickpeas, jeruk caang jeung bumbu seger. A lemon ganti baju brings eta sadayana babarengan.
salad.ingredients: Beets, kentang amis, chickpeas, jeruk, greens, peterseli, mint, wijen, lemon, minyak zaitun.

chicken.name: Lemon & bumbu hayam
chicken.short: Hayam emas, orok kentang, kacang héjo.
chicken.description: Hayam bakar ramuan kalayan kulit garing, kentang orok sareng kacang héjo. Dilayanan ku jeruk nipis sareng jus minyak zaitun.
chicken.ingredients: Hayam, kentang, kacang héjo, lemon, minyak zaitun, Rosemary, thyme, bawang bodas.

cake.name: Kue coklat ganache
cake.short: Coklat poék, krim vanili, buah prambus seger.
cake.description: A nyiksikan euyeub kueh lapisan coklat jeung ganache coklat poék herang. A krim vanili saeutik jeung buah prambus seger di sisi.
cake.ingredients: Coklat, tipung gandum, endog, mentega (susu), krim (susu), gula, vanili, buah prambus.

lemonade.name: Strawberry Basil limun
lemonade.short: Strawberry seger, lemon, basil & cai herang.
lemonade.description: A caang, limun enteng sparkling kalawan strawberries seger, a squeeze lemon na Basil seungit. Dilayanan leuwih és.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, lemon, basil, gula tebu, cai herang, és.

tea.name: És teh Jasmine
tea.short: Floral jasmine tea, lemon, loba és.
tea.description: Teh melati seger diseduh, tiis sareng dilayanan dina és sareng lemon. Unsweetened, kalayan finish kembang lembut.
tea.ingredients: Teh Jasmine, lemon, cai disaring, és. Ngandung kafein.
